description.en: Planned fossil-form study featuring deep hooked lower valve cups a much flatter upper lid.
description.zh: 拟议化石形态研究：深钩状下壳承接明显较平的上盖壳。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level planning concept with a named morphological source; inferred anatomy and artistic simplification are separate from observed fossil form.
scientific_scope.zh: 具有具名形态来源的属级规划方案；推断解剖和美术简化须与化石可见形态分开。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is deep hooked lower valve cups a much flatter upper lid; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以深钩状下壳承接明显较平的上盖壳为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish deep hooked lower valve cups a much flatter upper lid in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以深钩状下壳承接明显较平的上盖壳搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: Jurassic G. dilatata anchors the unequal-valve form; exact beak curvature and ornament must follow a selected specimen.
reference_notes: Period is representative, not a full range or a coexistence claim. Jurassic G. dilatata anchors the unequal-valve form; exact beak curvature and ornament must follow a selected specimen.

sources.title: TF0105: Gryphaea dilatata
sources.supports: Jurassic Gryphaea dilatata teaching specimen; strongly unequal flat right valve and curved left valve.
